note: St Hellier, Clumber Road East (#402) ten years on. John Campbell Boot is head at 32; his father Sir Jesse, now 71 and retired, and his mother Lady Florence are down as visitors in their own son's house. Import the 1911 file first: the three Boots are matched by name, so they gain a second census entry rather than a second record. The other eight are new. Two details the return settles — Jesse's birth year is 1850, which the 1911 ages had as 1851, and the employer columns style him "Bart", the baronetcy of 1917, eight years before the barony.
source: 1921 census, St Hellier, Clumber Road East — transcribed by A. Hagues
